purpose: Public source discovery for human-approved SCU event import; NO data published
notes: Source discovery is not event validation or authorization to republish.
M2 requires a correct same-day start/end time. Missing end times and all-day listings must stay pending.
No automated import, HTML scraping, or Qlusion API assumed.
Calendar department subviews may duplicate the official LiveWhale campus calendar.

sources.name: SCU campus calendar
sources.note: LiveWhale serves SCU's official calendar. API endpoint format documented by vendor; endpoint response has not been verified on this SCU instance.

sources.name: Qlusion SCU community events
sources.note: Qlusion lists SCU community event categories. No trustworthy, permitted machine-readable export or API established; do not scrape account-only information.

sources.name: SCU Theatre and Dance
sources.note: 2026-27 production pages list dates and some performance times, but individual event end times may be missing. Split verified performances into individual occurrences, never guess duration.

sources.name: SCU Music performance calendar
sources.note: Department performance news and dates; compare with official events calendar to avoid duplicates.

sources.name: Santa Clara Broncos athletics
sources.note: Official sport schedules contain event starts; game endings are often unknown, and away games are not campus activities. Do not fabricate end times.

sources.name: SCU Center for Student Involvement
sources.note: Organization directory helps identify official organizers. Do not turn a club listing into a dated event.

sources.name: SCU Career Center
sources.note: Appears to be a filtered view of the same SCU LiveWhale calendar; deduplicate by source occurrence ID, date and start.

sources.name: SCU Global Engagement calendar
sources.note: Same calendar platform. Check student eligibility, recurring office hours and event venue before proposing.

sources.name: SCU Recreation club sports schedules
sources.note: Club schedules may include competitions away from SCU and omit end times. Filter by eligibility and physical location.

sources.name: SCU Mission and Ministry
sources.note: Cross-check date, venue and access against the campus calendar.

sources.name: SCU Handshake career events
sources.note: Do not bypass sign-in, fetch student-only event details or expose restricted attendee information.
